scope: Dedicated manual source inventory and full-stack workflow checks, not general contract completeness or semantic certification
lessons: Missing-action discovery is separate from support classification of existing candidates
Original presence does not establish interpretation or event identity; adjacent actions can acquire combined actor links
Keep omitted and withheld findings in denominators and feedback; source indexing reconstructed own passages but actor/date resolution still failed
Never-sent reminders and cancelled meetings need explicit negative/plan coverage tests
A shortlist must preserve necessary premise clauses; do not turn inventory candidates into approved labels
